blocks.x: Threat Intelligence & Managed SOC delivered as an operating capability for the enterprise, not a slide deck — durable runtime, policy-checked actions, and telemetry your auditors can read without translation.
Threat Intelligence & Managed SOC in one paragraph: we measure the starting position honestly, design against your actual estate, and let the measured delta — not the deck — decide what scales.

blocks.title: Zero-trust verification mesh — Threat Intelligence & Managed SOC
blocks.note: The mesh treats models like any other principal — scoped credentials, audited calls and the same revocation path as people.

blocks.x: Every component in Threat Intelligence & Managed SOC has a contract, a version and a named owner. When something drifts, the ticket goes to a person, not to a committee — that is what the reference architecture is for.

The build sequence is deliberate: contracts and identity first, the working decision slice second, the verification harness third — because a Threat Intelligence & Managed SOC capability without its eval gate is just another unattended automation.
